# KM-103 — Scaffold `@khala/agent` (packages/agent) and harvest reusable agent code

**Lane:** agent · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-104 · **Serializes with:** KM-102 (`pnpm-lock.yaml`)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/**` (all new, except `packages/agent/README.md`, which KM-144 owns), `pnpm-lock.yaml` (agent importer only)

## Outcome

A new workspace package, `packages/agent`, that typechecks, runs its tests, and holds:
- the pinned `KhalaAgentClient` interface (C7) and the shared `KhalaClientError` in `src/client.ts`;
- the MCP stdio JSON-RPC transport, copied and stripped from `packages/agent-cli`, in `src/mcp/`;
- the Codex `codex queue` process runner, copied and stripped from `packages/harnesses`, in `src/wake/`;
- the final `bin/khala.mjs` dispatcher (contracts C12): it loads TypeScript through tsx and dispatches `khala mcp` to `src/mcp/main.ts` and `khala hook <name>` to `hooks/<name>.ts`. This ticket owns the bin entirely; no later ticket edits it (Round 2 R1).

The source packages are untouched; KM-124 deletes them later.

## Contract and invariants

C1 (verbatim row):

> | `@khala/agent` | `packages/agent` (new) | The agent MCP server, hooks, wakers, Claude plugin files and Codex config files. Bin `khala`. Runs from TypeScript source via `tsx` (hook scripts too) |

C7, verbatim. `src/client.ts` must match it exactly, **except** the `sendChannelEvent` line: it is "added by KM-173 (absent before it)", so this ticket omits it (its `ChannelEventContent` type does not exist until KM-170):

```ts
// packages/agent/src/client.ts
export interface KhalaAgentClient {
  join(link: string, label: string): Promise<{ state: 'awaiting_confirmation'; confirmUrl: string } | { state: 'connected'; channelName: string }>;
  status(): Promise<{ state: string; channelName?: string; agentUserId?: string; unread: number }>;
  read(limit: number, before?: string): Promise<{ messages: InboxEntry[]; nextBefore?: string }>;
  send(text: string): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;
  sendChannelEvent(content: ChannelEventContent): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;   // added by KM-173 (absent before it); errors as send()
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

export type KhalaErrorCode = 'invalid_link' | 'link_unavailable' | 'join_expired' | 'not_connected' | 'send_failed' | 'session_unknown' | 'internal_error';
export class KhalaClientError extends Error { readonly code: KhalaErrorCode; constructor(code: KhalaErrorCode, message?: string) }   // KM-103 ships it
```

KM-142, KM-143 and KM-144 consume `KhalaClientError`.

C1 (live tests, verbatim): "`*.live.test.ts` files are excluded from each package's default `test` script and run only via `test:live` (KM-110 sets this up for `packages/agent`; KM-150 does the same for any live test it adds)."

C8: "`matrix-js-sdk` is pinned to `42.4.0` in both `apps/web` and `packages/agent`."

C12 (verbatim; this ticket implements it in full):

```
khala --version            → prints KHALA_AGENT_VERSION from src/version.ts; exit 0
khala mcp [args…]          → import('../src/mcp/main.ts'); exit code = await mod.default(args)
khala hook <name> [args…]  → import('../hooks/<name>.ts');  exit code = await mod.default(stdin, args)
anything else              → stderr "usage: khala mcp | khala hook <name> | khala --version"; exit 1
```

```ts
// packages/agent/src/mcp/main.ts (KM-144 creates it; KM-150 wires the real client and the Codex waker into it)
export default async function main(argv: readonly string[]): Promise<number>;

// packages/agent/hooks/<name>.ts (KM-145: deliver.ts; KM-146: claude-wake.ts)
export default async function run(stdin: string, argv: readonly string[]): Promise<number>;
```

> - **Loading.** The bin calls `register()` from `tsx/esm/api` once, then loads every module with a dynamic `import()` relative to `import.meta.url`. `args`/`argv` are the arguments after `mcp`, or after `hook <name>`. For example, `khala hook deliver --harness codex` calls `run(stdin, ['--harness', 'codex'])`.
> - **Hook names.** `<name>` must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`, and `hooks/<name>.ts` must exist. There is no registry in the bin: creating `hooks/<name>.ts` is how a ticket adds a hook.
> - **Stdin.** For `hook`, the bin reads stdin to EOF as UTF-8, capped at 1 MiB, and passes it as `stdin`. Over the cap, or when stdin is a TTY, it passes `''`. Hook modules never read `process.stdin` themselves.
> - **Exit codes.**
>   - The module's resolved number becomes `process.exitCode`. That is how `claude-wake` exits 2 to wake Claude; every other hook returns 0.
>   - An unknown or invalid hook name, or a missing `hooks/<name>.ts` → stderr `khala: unknown hook <name>`, exit **1**.
>   - `mcp` before `src/mcp/main.ts` exists → stderr `khala: mcp not available`, exit **1**.
>   - A module that throws, or resolves to a non-number → stderr `{"ok":false,"warning":"khala_hook_suppressed","code":"internal_error"}` for `hook` (`khala: internal_error` for `mcp`), exit **1**.
>   - **The bin itself never exits 2.** An `asyncRewake` hook that exits 2 wakes Claude, so only a module's own return value may be 2.
> - **Output.** The bin writes nothing to stdout. Modules own stdout (JSON-RPC lines for `mcp`, the C6 envelope for `deliver`).

### Worked example

`package.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "@khala/agent",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "engines": { "node": ">=22.23.2" },
  "bin": { "khala": "./bin/khala.mjs" },
  "exports": { "./package.json": "./package.json" },
  "scripts": {
    "typecheck": "node ../../scripts/package-task.mjs typecheck",
    "test": "vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests"
  },
  "dependencies": { "@khala/contracts": "workspace:*", "matrix-js-sdk": "42.4.0", "tsx": "4.20.6" }
}
```

There is no `build` script: the package runs from source through tsx. Do not add a live test or a `test:live` script here; KM-110 adds `test:live` and excludes `*.live.test.ts` from `test` (C1).

`tsconfig.json` is `packages/harnesses/tsconfig.json` with one change: `include` also lists `"hooks/**/*.ts"`. Hook modules (KM-145 `hooks/deliver.ts`, KM-146 `hooks/claude-wake.ts`) live outside `src/`, and without this line `pnpm --filter ./packages/agent typecheck` would never check them (the copied file includes only `src/**`). Tests stay under `src/` because the root `vitest.config.ts:11` collects only `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}`.

```json
{
  "extends": "../../tsconfig.base.json",
  "compilerOptions": { "outDir": "dist" },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "src/**/*.tsx", "hooks/**/*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["dist", "node_modules"]
}
```

`bin/khala.mjs` (C12; the shape to follow, about 50 lines):

```js
#!/usr/bin/env node
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { register } from 'tsx/esm/api';
register();
const HOOK_NAME = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/;
const STDIN_CAP = 1024 * 1024;
const [cmd, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);

async function readStdin() {
  if (process.stdin.isTTY) return '';
  const chunks = []; let size = 0;
  for await (const chunk of process.stdin) { size += chunk.length; if (size > STDIN_CAP) return ''; chunks.push(chunk); }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
}
function exitWith(code) { process.exitCode = code; }

if (cmd === '--version') {
  const { KHALA_AGENT_VERSION } = await import('../src/version.ts'); console.log(KHALA_AGENT_VERSION); exitWith(0);
} else if (cmd === 'mcp') {
  const url = new URL('../src/mcp/main.ts', import.meta.url);
  if (!existsSync(url)) { console.error('khala: mcp not available'); exitWith(1); }
  else {
    try {
      const code = await (await import(url.href)).default(rest);
      if (typeof code !== 'number') throw new Error('bad_exit');
      exitWith(code);
    } catch { console.error('khala: internal_error'); exitWith(1); }
  }
} else if (cmd === 'hook') {
  const [name = '', ...args] = rest;
  const url = new URL(`../hooks/${name}.ts`, import.meta.url);
  if (!HOOK_NAME.test(name) || !existsSync(url)) { console.error(`khala: unknown hook ${name}`); exitWith(1); }
  else {
    try {
      const code = await (await import(url.href)).default(await readStdin(), args);
      if (typeof code !== 'number') throw new Error('bad_exit');
      exitWith(code);
    } catch { process.stderr.write('{"ok":false,"warning":"khala_hook_suppressed","code":"internal_error"}\n'); exitWith(1); }
  }
} else {
  console.error('usage: khala mcp | khala hook <name> | khala --version'); exitWith(1);
}
```

Use `process.exitCode`, not `process.exit()`, so pending stdout writes flush. No branch of the bin ever sets 2; only a module's returned value can.

MCP exchange that the harvested server must produce, with a one-tool registry (`khala_probe` returns text `hello`):

```
→ {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{}}}
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":false}},"serverInfo":{"name":"khala","version":"0.0.0"}}}
→ {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"_meta":{"threadId":"t-1"},"name":"khala_probe","arguments":{}}}
   (tool receives context { id: 2, notification: false, meta: { threadId: "t-1" } })
← {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"hello"}]}}
```

## Test scenarios

`packages/agent/src/client.test.ts`:
1. `new KhalaClientError('join_expired')` → `instanceof Error`, `.code === 'join_expired'`, `.message === 'join_expired'`, `.name === 'KhalaClientError'`.

`packages/agent/src/mcp/registry.test.ts`. Port `registry.test.ts:1-70`. Its `exchange` helper calls `runMcpServer({ input, output, tools })`.
2. A duplicate name → `ToolRegistryError` with `reason === 'duplicate_tool'`.
3. Names `''`, `'Khala'`, `'a-b'` and `'__proto__'` → throw `/invalid_name/`. `resolve('constructor')` → `undefined`.
4. An unknown tool call → `{ error: { code: -32602, message: 'Invalid params' } }`.
5. A registry with `khala_probe` → `tools/list` returns exactly `['khala_probe']`, and the call returns `hello`.

`packages/agent/src/mcp/server.test.ts`. Port the transport cases with a probe tool.
6. The worked example: `initialize` with any version → `protocolVersion: '2025-03-26'`, `serverInfo.name === 'khala'`.
7. `_meta: { progressToken: 0 }` on `initialize`, `tools/list` and `ping` → ok. `_meta: 'x'` → -32602. `tools/list` with `cursor` → -32602 (from `:262-277`).
8. `tools/call` with `_meta: { threadId: 't-1' }` → the tool sees `meta` deep-equal to `{ threadId: 't-1' }` and `notification === false`.
9. A notification (no `id`) → no response line (from `:289-305`).
10. A tool that throws `Error('secret-x')` → `result.isError === true` and `structuredContent.error === 'internal_error'`. The output does not contain `secret-x`.
11. A multibyte argument split across two chunks decodes (from `:314-323`).
12. Aborting with an idle input → `runMcpServer` resolves (from `:325-336`).
13. A 90 000-byte unterminated frame → -32600, then a following `ping` answers (from `:338-353`).
14. A pipelined second call waits for the first write (from `:568-591`).
15. A blocked write aborts without processing queued work (from `:593-622`).

`packages/agent/src/wake/idle-wake.test.ts`:
16. `codexIdleWakeArgv('thread-1')` → `['queue', '--thread', 'thread-1', '--message', CODEX_IDLE_WAKE_NOTICE]`.
17. The notice contains no `{`, newline or `$`.

`packages/agent/src/wake/idle-wake-process.test.ts`:
18. The 5 copied cases pass unchanged.

`packages/agent/src/bin.test.ts` (C12). Spawn `process.execPath` on a temp copy of `bin/khala.mjs` placed at `<tmp>/bin/khala.mjs`, with fixture modules written to `<tmp>/src/mcp/main.ts` and `<tmp>/hooks/<name>.ts` by the test, and `<tmp>/node_modules` symlinked to the package's `node_modules` so `tsx` resolves. Never create these fixtures inside `packages/agent/`.
19. No `src/mcp/main.ts` → `mcp` exits 1 with stderr `khala: mcp not available`. A fixture `main` that returns `argv.length` → `khala mcp a b` exits 2 (the module's value passes through).
20. A fixture hook `echo.ts` whose `run(stdin, argv)` writes `JSON.stringify({stdin, argv})` to stdout and returns 0 → `printf '{"x":1}' | khala hook echo --harness codex` prints `{"stdin":"{\"x\":1}","argv":["--harness","codex"]}`, exit 0.
21. `khala hook nope` and `khala hook ../x` → exit 1, stderr `khala: unknown hook <name>`; never 2.
22. A fixture hook that throws → exit 1, stderr exactly `{"ok":false,"warning":"khala_hook_suppressed","code":"internal_error"}`; a fixture returning 2 → exit 2.
23. Stdin larger than 1 MiB → the fixture receives `''`.
24. `khala` and `khala bogus` → usage on stderr, exit 1. `khala --version` → `0.0.0`, exit 0.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm --filter ./packages/agent typecheck
pnpm --filter ./packages/agent test
node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs --version      # prints 0.0.0 (proves tsx loads src/*.ts)
node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs mcp; echo $?   # "khala: mcp not available", 1 (until KM-144 adds src/mcp/main.ts)
node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs hook deliver </dev/null; echo $?   # "khala: unknown hook deliver", 1 (until KM-145)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm check:boundaries
```

Done when the following hold:
- all of the above pass;
- `git diff --stat` shows only new files under `packages/agent/` plus `pnpm-lock.yaml`;
- `packages/agent-cli` and `packages/harnesses` are unchanged;
- `pnpm --filter @aiur/khala exec pwd` still prints only `packages/agent-cli`.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if `packages/contracts/src/m1/inbox.ts` (KM-104) is not on `main`, because `client.ts` cannot typecheck without it. Do not create a local `InboxEntry`.
- **Stop** if `node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs --version` fails to load `src/version.ts` through tsx. Report the error; do not switch loaders.
- **Stop** if `pnpm typecheck` fails in a package other than `packages/agent`. Report it; do not fix it.
- Do not rename `packages/agent-cli`, and do not use the name `@aiur/khala` here.

## Complexity rationale

2: a mechanical copy-and-strip of about 450 lines with known line ranges, plus boilerplate and a fully specified 50-line dispatcher (C12). The name and loader decisions are made in this ticket.
